options.label: Chip on the panel + 'offline mode' on the mic light
options.notes: Built now (the default). An amber 'Offline mode' chip next to the listener switch with the reason on hover and a line under it; the banner mic light keeps its colour and adds '· offline mode' to its label.

options.label: Chip on the panel only
options.notes: The banner mic light stays exactly as it is; only the settings panel shows the amber 'Offline mode' chip and its reason. Quietest on the banner.

options.label: Mic light turns amber while offline
options.notes: The banner mic light's dot turns the warning tone and its label reads 'Mic on: offline mode' while Claude mode is on but Claude is away; the panel chip shows the reason. Most visible from any screen.
